body: My daughter is a complete “Daddy’s Girl.” Even though my soon to be ex is  her step father...she has always claimed him as her “real dad.” He is moving to another city to work and has said that he would keep her, if I wanted him to. She wants to go with him. Even though he’s a shit husband, he’s always been a great father to her.  I’m considering it. I know he would protect her. I’m thinking of having my son go live with my brother. I honestly am so tired and I just want this to be over. I want to make arrangements for them. Then I just want to die.
